title: An 11:50 pm bedtime with default quiet hours: a few words that ZOH will still reach them, no question, nothing about quiet hours after lock
origin: Issue #48 (quiet hours move to fit the step time), the spec's planning example
testerLines: Sunday to Thursday, weekends I'm out late anyway
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: before #48 ZOH offered to move quiet hours, then could offer again after lock because it no longer saw the earlier offer.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH shows the plan (bed by 11:50 pm with screens away, Sunday to Thursday, with a photo as proof) and says in a few words that it will stay up to reach them around then (for example a heads-up at 11:40), with no question about quiet hours; the text ends with one question about the plan. After 'looks good' it asks for the commitment in natural words; after 'I'm in' it locks with a hype line and when day 1 is. It never asks to move quiet hours or brings them up again.

answers.what: in bed with screens away, phone charging in the kitchen

history.text: I want to be in bed by 11:50 with my phone charging in the kitchen
Love that, Dana. Which nights do you want this to happen?
